scenario.title: Mars: A Light That Answers
scenario.premise: A damaged landing strands a small expedition. Recovery becomes a rescue, then a return journey carrying people and evidence. This is an engineering story with recovered qualified systems, not real survival instructions.

stage.title: Somewhere to come back to
stage.speaker: Mission Control
stage.motivation: The inner cabin survived, but the landing tore its vestibule. Make the entry weather-tight, store water, and protect a living tray. Move our signal to the cabin’s clear-sky mast: the missing survey crew need a refuge to aim for, not just our crash site.

newSupplies.label: Somewhere to come back to stores
